name: ontology
title: ontology
blurb: a short essay on who gets to decide what a follow, a like, or a friend even is — usenet's killfiles, phpBB's post counts, the friends-list-as-permission on LiveJournal, the social graph as product, twitter breaking the follow's symmetry, and atproto putting the schema of a social relation into a public lexicon. @shibbi.me asked for a history of the ontology of social platforms.
